correctness.rationale: The Witt addition law gives the exact quintic Artin–Schreier model \(a=\lambda\), \(b=\lambda+\lambda^{1/2}+1\), and \(c=1+\lambda^{1/4}\). Hyperelliptic-map rigidity forces an affine change of coordinate; coefficient comparison makes \(b^5/a^3\) necessary, while the explicit degree-sixteen translation equation has a solution over the algebraically closed field and proves sufficiency. Frobenius injectivity yields the stated \(J\). Its derivative \(Q^4/\lambda^6\) and degree ten prove separability and the ten-to-two fiber dichotomy. Exact polynomial and finite-field checks pass. No finite experiment substitutes for the proof.
